image.alternativeText: Founder in a bright office corridor

items.title: THE SITUATION
items.description: A founder was approaching a key business milestone and wanted additional runway without another equity round. The cap table was already under pressure and dilution was a real cost.

items.title: THE DECISION
items.description: Capitar structured venture debt around the business’s needs — size, tenor and schedule built around the milestone, not a standard template.

items.title: THE OUTCOME
items.description: The company gained additional runway to reach its next milestone without equity dilution at an uncertain moment. The round that followed reflected that.
